organisations.chooseText: You belong to {count, plural, one {# organisation} other {# organisations}}.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Product sections appear in the rail as they are added. There is nothing else to do here right now.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.text: These follow you to every organisation and device.
preferences.nameNote: Your name shows to the members of every organisation you belong to.

invitations.invitedAs: {inviter} invited you to join {tenant} as {role, select, owner {an Owner} admin {an Admin} member {a Member} other {{roleName}}}
invitations.joinsWith: You join with the email <email></email>. The invitation only works for this address.
invitations.newPersonText: Tell your colleagues who you are. These names appear in the member list and in Activity.
invitations.expiredText: The link to join {tenant} expired on {date}. Ask {inviter} to invite you again.
invitations.cancelledText: The invitation to join {tenant} was withdrawn or replaced by a newer one. Check your inbox for a newer email, or ask {inviter} to invite you again.
invitations.acceptedText: You are a member of {tenant}. Open it to continue.
invitations.wrongEmailTitle: This invitation is for a different email
invitations.wrongEmailText: You’re signed in as <email></email>. Sign in with the email that received the invitation.
invitations.systemAdminTitle: System admins can’t join an organisation
invitations.tenantSuspendedText: You can join when it is active again.

permissionDenied.title: You can’t open {page}
permissionDenied.text: Your role in {organisation} is {role}. Owners and Admins can read {page}. Ask one of them if you need something from it.

members.title: Members
members.name: Name
members.noMembersMatchText: Check the spelling or search by email.
members.noInvitationsMatchText: Check the spelling of the email.
members.noInvitationsText: People you invite appear here until they join or the link expires.
members.removeSelf: You cannot remove yourself. Ask another Owner or Admin.
members.changeOwner: Only an Owner can change an Owner.
members.removeOwner: Only an Owner can remove an Owner.

roleDescriptions.owner: Everything, including giving and taking the Owner role.
roleDescriptions.admin: Invites members, changes roles, removes members, reads Activity.
roleDescriptions.member: Uses the product. Sees the member list, not Activity or Invitations.

members.changeRoleText: {name} is {role, select, owner {an Owner} admin {an Admin} member {a Member} other {{roleName}}} in {organisation}. The change applies at once.
members.roleChangedText: {name} is now {role, select, owner {an Owner} admin {an Admin} member {a Member} other {{roleName}}}.
members.removeText: They lose access at once. Their past activity stays in the log. You can invite them again later.
members.lastOwnerChange: Make someone else an Owner first, then change this role.
members.lastOwnerRemove: Make someone else an Owner first, then remove this member.
members.ownerRequiresOwnerChange: Only an Owner can give or take the Owner role.
members.ownerRequiresOwnerChangeText: Ask an Owner of {organisation} to make this change.
members.ownerRequiresOwnerRemove: Only an Owner can remove an Owner.
members.memberGoneChange: Someone removed them while this dialog was open. The list has been refreshed.
members.memberGoneRemove: Someone removed them already. The list has been refreshed.
members.revokeText: The link in their email stops working at once. You can invite them again later.
members.cancelText: Its link already stopped working. This removes it from the list. You can invite them again later.
members.alreadyJoinedText: Nothing to revoke. The list has been refreshed.
members.inviteText: They get an email with a link to join. If this address already has a pending invitation, the new one replaces it.
members.revokeOwnerHint: Only an Owner can revoke this invitation.
members.inviteLanguageHint: The invitation email and their first screens use this language. They can change it later.
members.dailyLimitText: You have reached today’s invitation limit.
members.inviteOwner: Only an Owner can invite an Owner.
members.inviteOwnerText: Choose Admin or Member, or ask an Owner to send this invitation.
members.giveOwner: Only an Owner can give the Owner role.
members.roleOutOfReach: This role has permissions your role doesn’t have.
members.roleOutOfReachText: Choose another role, or ask an Owner.
members.roleOutOfReachAsk: Ask an Owner of {organisation} to do this.
members.rolesUnreadable: Your role can’t read roles, so it can’t do this.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyText: Changes to members, invitations and the organisation appear here.

member.role_changed: <actor></actor> changed the role of <target></target> from <oldRole></oldRole> to <newRole></newRole>.

role.updated: <actor></actor> changed the role <target></target>{change, select, both {: added <added></added>, removed <removed></removed>} added {: added <added></added>} removed {: removed <removed></removed>} other {}}.

system_admin.revoked: <actor></actor> revoked the system admin access of <target></target>.

tenant.purge_warned: The Owners were told that <target></target> will be deleted on {date}.
tenant.purged: <actor></actor> deleted this organisation and its data.

blocked.suspendedText: You cannot open this organisation right now. Your data and your membership are kept. Contact your organisation’s Owner if you need to know more.
blocked.closedText: This organisation was closed and cannot be opened. Your data is kept for now. Contact your organisation’s Owner if you need to know more.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.text: You cannot sign in right now. Contact support.

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: Owner, Admin and Member are built in. Create a role when a person needs a different set of permissions.
roles.name: Name
roles.usageInvitations: {count, plural, one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
roles.counter: {count} of {max, plural, one {# custom role} other {# custom roles}}
roles.limitReached: Your organisation has reached its limit of {max, plural, one {# custom role} other {# custom roles}}. Delete one to create another.
roles.outOfReach: This role has permissions your role doesn’t have.
roles.noCustomText: Create a role when Owner, Admin and Member don’t fit.
roles.rolesReadNeeded: Needed to invite people, change roles, remove members and revoke invitations.
roles.lacks: Your role doesn’t have this permission.
roles.profileReadRequired: Every role must see the organisation’s details.
roles.ownerOnly: Manage Owners belongs to the Owner role only.
roles.permissionInvalid: One of these permissions doesn’t exist any more. Reload the page.
roles.builtInTitle: Built-in roles can’t be edited or deleted.
roles.builtInText: Create a custom role to give a different set of permissions.
roles.discardText: Your changes are not saved. You can keep editing and save them.
roles.deleteText: People can no longer get this role. Activity keeps its name.
roles.inUseText: Someone gave it to a member or an invitation a moment ago. The list has been refreshed.
roles.escalationAsk: Ask an Owner to delete it.
